ModMetaData.name: CeleTech Duplicate Equippable Comp Fix (Local Patch)
ModMetaData.author: meidocho
ModMetaData.description:
Local patch for CeleTech Arsenal MKIII (3446237098), RimWorld 1.6 only.
Root cause: several CeleTech weapon defs end up with two comps deriving from vanilla CompEquippable on the same weapon. Every CompEquippable-derived comp saves its own verbTracker node into the thing's save data, and IVerbOwner.UniqueVerbOwnerID() is "CompEquippable_" + ThingID for all of them, so both trackers write verbs with identical loadIDs. Saving reports duplicate verb IDs (DebugLoadIDsSavingErrorsChecker) and loading fails with duplicate registration errors.
Two duplicate patterns fixed (weapon defs only, no save edits): 1. Child defs inheriting TOT_Weapons_WithGizmo re-declare CompProperties_PawnEquipmentGizmo that the abstract parent already provides: QBZ71_QS, QTS9_OICW, W85XWJ, QBZS85XWJ, QBZ_eightfiveAR. Fix: remove the redundant child declaration; the parent's comp stays. 2. Defs inheriting TOT_Weapons (vanilla BaseWeapon chain provides CompEquippable) that add CompProperties_LegendaryWeapons: TangDaoPersona, CMC_EMPsword_sevenstars. Fix: set Inherit="False" on the def's comps node (same pattern CeleTech itself uses in TOT_Weapons_WithGizmo), keep the def's own comps, re-add the inherited non-equippable comps (Forbiddable, Styleable, CompQuality), and replace the child's Art node with the exact inherited Gun-grammar values (the inherited Gun-grammar CompArt was the active one before the fix; this preserves art naming/description behavior). CompLegendaryWeapons derives from CompEquippable, so it remains the single verb owner and all GetComp/TryGetComp<CompEquippable> consumers keep working.
Known behavior gap handled by the included Harmony patch: CompLegendaryWeapons.Notify_Unequipped overrides without calling base, so once it is the sole equippable comp the CompEquippable verb-loss callbacks (Verb.Notify_EquipmentLost: cancels warmup stance / AttackStatic job) would stop firing. The patch adds a scoped prefix on CompLegendaryWeapons.Notify_Unequipped that fires Notify_EquipmentLost once per verb for TangDaoPersona and CMC_EMPsword_sevenstars only, before the original ability removal. It resolves the target by reflection (no compile dependency on CeleTech) and deliberately does not invoke the base method (virtual dispatch would recurse).
Special functions preserved: equipment gizmos (CompPawnEquipmentGizmo), legendary abilities/biocoding (CompLegendaryWeapons), quality/forbiddable/styleable behavior, and the pre-fix art grammar. Not covered: 1.5 (the 1.5 def set has no WithGizmo duplicate; only 1.6 is advertised), other mods' weapons, save files.
